title: Careful! Misleading & Predatory Subscription Setup
body:
I downloaded this app after seeing an ad on social media that linked directly to the App Store. The ad promoted a cheap trial, so I tried it—but the moment I opened the app, I realized it offered nothing useful and suspected it might be a scam.
The biggest issue is that the app does not show what subscriptions it signs you up for, and there is no way to cancel from inside the app. Even worse, when you install through the social-media link, the subscriptions do not appear in your Apple Subscriptions list, so you have no way of knowing what you’re being charged for.
Because of this, I was charged multiple amounts without my consent, and I still haven’t been able to get my money back. After searching online, I saw many others reporting the same pattern.
This setup feels extremely predatory. Please be very careful and do not leave your payment information with this app.
author: a_zin

title: BEWARE: No refunds given, unhelpful support team
body:
Didn’t like the app, found the cartoons a bit too childish for an adult looking for assistance with time management. However, after signing up it is difficult to navigate the app and figure out how and where to get your account cancelled - there’s no way to do it yourself? You have to get in contact and request an account cancellation and wait up to 2 days for a confirmation? I thought I had done it a while back, but clearly not as they charged my card again, and when I went to dispute it and ask for a refund and for my account to be truly cancelled I was told there’s no refunds and that on the initial sign up the renewal date is clearly stated (although nowhere to be found within the app). Got charged now AGAIN this morning after this whole saga happening a few weeks ago - having to finally now go through my bank to get this company to STOP taking money off me.

Sneaky and unprofessional to continue charging once an account has supposedly been cancelled. Why isn’t there just a button to cancel the account? Why do I have to go through submitting a request to have my account cancelled and wait 2 days for a reply???

title: Unexpected
body: As someone with severe to extreme ADHD, it's no surprise that I'm not the greatest on staying atop free trial offers and pending subscription payments.  When I found two charges totalling $113.98 on my credit card, my immediate assumption was I would be in for a hassle requesting a refund. I am very grateful that this isn't the case with this developer. Within minutes of requesting the refund, it was processed and my bank confirmation email was in my in-box. To say I was shocked and pleasently surprised is an understatement.  Despite my cancelling as a customer, they maintained an outstanding level of customer care and service that is rarity even by companies of which I have a long history and loyalty. When my financial situation improves, I fully anticipate returning as a customer. Thank you.

title: Preying on the ADHD community with shady billing practices.
body: Fabulous markets itself as a solution for people with ADHD — and then turns around and weaponizes executive dysfunction. If you don't cancel your free trial "24hours before the end of the free trial period", you will get charged -- and you wouldn't have seen that unless you read the very last of the fine print (WHO with ADHD is doing that? nobody! -- and they know it). I unsubscribed and deleted my account, but they continued trying to charge my card daily. If your business model profits off of the very symptoms you're claiming to help treat, you're part of the problem. Left such a bad taste in my mouth.

title: Amazing app, extremely poor support
body: I hate to leave such a bad review for an amazing app, but I can’t get past the technical support issues and this is my last resort. Hopefully the review will spur support to contact me, and if not I feel like others should be warned before spending valuable time (and money if springing for the membership - I have yearly premiums because the apps are so great). I’ve had on and off issues with my account, getting logged out and cannot log back in with existing or changed passwords. When I contact support they reply several days later with basic troubleshooting steps, which I had explained I already tried in the original ticket. If I reply to that response, I never get another response so have to submit another ticket for the same problem.  This happens across all Fabulous apps (I have the same issue on Clarify and Elixir), so when one goes down your on your own on multiple fronts. It’s extra rough since the apps have been working amazing for me in terms of habit building, so when I loose access to the apps I loose my support system ☹️

title: Please be careful
body:
If I hadn’t seen another review warning about the payment structure, I would’ve fallen for it for sure because of how confusing it is.

** Make sure to cancel the trial right away to avoid a bad surprise**

The trial is aprox. 1$ to 20$,  “pay what you can”. The subscription is $54, billed every 3 months. All this is done through their site, not the App. 

The app itself is just too much of nothing for me. Low key, the whole experience felt a tad predatory/exploitative.

I wouldn't mind paying that price for something of true value, but you’re just better off learning how to properly use your free Reminders app.

author: darkangel 080i

title: AMAZING APP
body: This app is the best ADHD app I have found so far. I have been looking for something like this for a while, and it is better than I could have imagined! I rarely write reviews, so this really means something. There has been so much time and effort put into this app, with beautiful and engaging graphics and the app tailors everything to you. It is not one of those boring apps that claim to be “great for ADHD” but designed for neurotypicals. It even has ADHD coaches for no extra charge! This app helps me with my anxiety too, with cool factors like emotional anchoring and writing a letter to future you. The price is a bit steep, but developers understand that we forget things, so if you forget to cancel your trial, they give you a full refund anyways! I 10/10 recommend. The only things I wish would be added is something for structure, like creating a day plan & checklists? Breaking down tasks is super useful, too. I also think it would be good if there was a little collection of stickers or something to reward you occasionally. If you are reading this, seriously, try it out, it has worked really well for me!

title: So Slow
body:

This app may work for some, IF you can get through the quiz and the tutorials. 

Not for me.
